contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMPCMAVRSEVALEXANDAVG ; R/ PMTR PII COSPP

Silver Coin. Denarius of Severus Alexander (222-235), mint of issue of 223, RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 23. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: IMPCMAVRSEVALEXANDAVG. Reverse description: Mars standing left with spear and olive branch. Reverse inscription: PMTR PII COSPP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 3.09gms, die axis: 12
